name: SHA-1 Hash Generator
description: Generate the SHA-1 hash of any text instantly using your browser's built-in Web Crypto API — nothing you type ever leaves your device.

faq.question: Is SHA-1 secure?
faq.answer: Not anymore for adversarial use — practical collision attacks against SHA-1 were demonstrated in 2017 (the "SHAttered" attack), so it's deprecated for digital signatures and TLS certificates. It's still fine for non-adversarial checksums and is required for compatibility with older systems (e.g. Git's historical object hashing) that haven't migrated. Prefer SHA-256 for new security-sensitive work.

faq.question: How is this computed?
faq.answer: Via your browser's native Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle.digest), the same implementation browsers use internally for TLS — not a hand-rolled reimplementation, so it's fast and matches every other correct SHA-1 implementation byte-for-byte.
